svg.title: The Fetch
svg.desc: A northern lake under a leaden sky. The water is dark at the near shore and pale toward the far one because the wind had a longer run to build the sea there; wave crests crowd toward the horizon at one deep-water wavelength each. Generated procedurally from a stipulated basin and the SMB fetch relations.
